toastServerError: We couldn't reach the server. Please try again.

installHint: Add it to your home screen to open it like an app.
installIOSHint: In Safari, tap Share and then "Add to Home Screen".
heroLead: Enter sizes, edges and parts from your phone. {{name}} gets your cut list ready to saw and lets you know when to pick it up.
howTitle: From the workshop to the saw in three steps
howLead: No calls, no paper notes and no mistakes when reading out sizes.
step1Text: Write down length, width, quantity and which sides get edge banding. All from your phone, in millimeters.
step2Text: Your order goes straight to the lumberyard, which lays out the parts on each board and confirms price and delivery.
step3Title: Pick up or get it delivered
step3Text: We let you know when your parts are cut and edged, ready to assemble.
serviceCutsText: Melamine, MDF and plywood cut to the millimeter, with the best usage per board.
serviceEdgesText: Choose which sides of each part get edge banding and we apply it.
serviceFurnitureText: Kitchens, closets and drawer units: order the full cut list of a piece of furniture.
serviceAiText: Take photos of the kitchen with its measurements and get a render with a suggested cut list.
ctaText: Create your account and place your first order in minutes. Install the app to keep it handy in the workshop.
authAside1: Order cuts and parts at any time
authAside2: Save your projects and repeat orders
authAside3: Get notified when your order is ready
loginSubtitle: Use your {{name}} account to place and track orders.
registerSubtitle: It's free and takes less than a minute.
usernameHint: Letters and numbers only, no spaces.
usernameFormat: Use letters and numbers only, no spaces.
homeFeatureTitle: Build your cut list in minutes
homeFeatureText: Enter sizes, edges and grain for each part. The lumberyard gets everything ready to cut.
homeQuickKitchen: Kitchen photos → render and cut list
homeQuickOrders: Check how your orders are going
homeQuickProfileMissing: Add your phone so they can reach you
ordersEmptyText: Once you send your first order you'll see its progress here, from received to ready for pickup.
ordersSubtitle: Everything you've ordered from the lumberyard.
stagesSubtitle: We'll let you know at every step.
pieceAddSubtitle: Length is the side that follows the grain.
pieceGrainHint: The part is not rotated when laid out on the board.
pieceErrorDims: Enter the part's length and width.
pieceErrorQty: Quantity must be a whole number greater than 0.
pieceErrorBoard: The part doesn't fit on a {{length}} × {{width}} mm board.
piecesEmptyText: Add the first part with the form above.
materialPerPieceHint: Each piece keeps its own material: you can mix boards in the same order.
draftSaved: Your draft is saved on this device.
materialsUnavailableText: The lumberyard hasn't published its boards on Veta yet. Try again later.
materialsErrorText: Check your connection and try again.
sendOrderFixPieces: Fix the pieces marked in red before sending ({{count}}).
summaryUnpriced: Some prices are to be confirmed: the lumberyard fills them in when it reviews your order.
summaryEstimateHint: Prices include taxes. Sheets are estimated at {{usage}}% yield; the lumberyard confirms the total when it optimizes the cut.
ordersErrorText: Check your connection and try again.
orderNotFoundText: The link may be wrong, or the order may belong to another account.
orderCreatedText: The lumberyard has it and will let you know once they confirm price and delivery.
orderCreatedTextPay: The lumberyard has it. You can pay now, or wait until they confirm the total after optimizing the cut.
orderPayHint: You pay by card on Stripe. If the lumberyard adjusts the total, you'll see the balance here.
orderPayAtStore: This order is paid directly at the lumberyard.
orderNoDue: This order has no balance due.
kitchenSubtitle: Take photos, add measurements and get a render with a suggested cut list.
kitchenStep1Text: One front photo per wall, in good light.
kitchenStep2Text: Width and height of each wall, and where the sink, stove and windows go.
kitchenStep3Text: See how the kitchen would look and get the cut list to order it.
kitchenDropText: On your phone you can use the camera directly.
kitchenSoonHint: We're finishing this feature. Your photos stay on this device.
profileAccountSubtitle: The lumberyard uses these details to contact you about your orders.
appInstalled: Veta is already installed on this device.
appInstallUnavailable: Open this page on your phone to install the app.
tenantNotFoundText: Check that the address is spelled right or ask your lumberyard for the link.
tenantErrorText: Check your internet connection and try again.
modulesSubtitle: Cabinets ready to order: the lumber yard takes care of the cut list and cutting.
modulesEmptyText: The lumber yard hasn't published modules in Veta yet. Meanwhile, you can enter your pieces.
modulesPriceHint: Price with taxes based on the module's material. The lumber yard confirms the total when reviewing your order.
orderModuleUnavailable: This module is no longer available
sendOrderFixModules: Remove the modules that are no longer available ({{count}}).
